claim: Runs the full release flow without setup in a new temporary folder.
sandbox: empty environment; bundled sample; assert a new OS temporary directory and pocket

claim: Writes an install page, QR link, checksums, release JSON, and prior releases.
sandbox: arp demo output; assert each file, QR markup, and matching checksum

claim: CLI checks and release generation run on the user's computer without network access.
sandbox: LD_PRELOAD network guard around arp demo; assert no connect call

claim: The CLI is free under the MIT license.
sandbox: assert Cargo package metadata and shipped license text

claim: The macOS and Linux installer verifies SHA-256 before installing arp.
sandbox: local manifest server; assert mismatched archive is refused and matching archive installs

claim: Demo approval notes stay separate and are removed when the visitor leaves demo mode.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; add a note, inspect demo namespace, then leave

sandbox: demo license; add an approval and assert the downloaded JSON file

claim: A successful license check is reused for one day.

sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; assert every request is same-origin and document.cookie is empty
